title: Television control experiment (30 subjects, 4 classes, 31 EEG ch)
description: A P300-based brain-computer interface dataset for television control comprising EEG recordings from 30 healthy subjects performing a visual oddball task. The dataset includes 31-channel EEG data acquired at 500 Hz using the actiCHamp system, with target and non-target stimulus classifications for home appliance control applications. This derivative dataset was processed and standardized using the MOABB framework and is formatted according to BIDS specifications.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 30 healthy subjects (mean age 21.63±2.31 years) using a 31-channel actiCHamp system (Brain Products) at 500 Hz sampling rate with linked mastoid reference. Subjects performed a visual P300 oddball task with flash stimuli presented on an LCD display at 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Each subject completed one session with 50 training and 30 testing blocks. Online visual feedback was provided during the task.
